scope: freertos fixed task for mpu6050, bus=i2c, board=stm32f103rb; contract describes only APIs needed by the copied reference driver and task fixed binding.

operations.name: HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit(I2C_HandleTypeDef *, uint16_t, uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: polling API used directly by reference; honor parameters and return value.

operations.name: HAL_I2C_Master_Receive
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_I2C_Master_Receive(I2C_HandleTypeDef *, uint16_t, uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: polling API used directly by reference; honor parameters and return value.

operations.name: HAL_I2C_Mem_Read
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_I2C_Mem_Read(I2C_HandleTypeDef *, uint16_t, uint16_t, uint16_t, uint8_t *, uint16_t, uint32_t Timeout)
operations.semantics: polling API used directly by reference; honor parameters and return value.

api_contract.preconditions: Caller provides the task-configured and initialized peripheral handle; helper APIs have the RTOS/HAL context documented in the baseline pack.

facts.requirement: Retain the fixed FreeRTOS task's i2c handle/device type and prebound context; the caller supplies the bus instance configured according to task_requirements.

Retain the polling operations actually used by the reference implementation: HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit, HAL_I2C_Master_Receive, HAL_I2C_Mem_Read. Parameter and return semantics must support the i2c access required by mpu6050.
